scope: Synthetic AssetGroupBroker range-read microbenchmark; not a full browser or model-inference benchmark.

environment.optimized: AssetGroupBroker with 32 MiB grant-scoped verified-chunk LRU

method.chunk_source: Deterministic synthetic immutable chunks, admitted and verified before timing each run.
method.request_offsets: Contiguous, non-overlapping ranges beginning at offset zero in the same chunk.
checks: Every returned byte in every measured range was compared with the deterministic source bytes.
The output checksum matched between baseline and optimized runs for each workload.
Store getChunk calls and returned bytes were counted after admission.
WebCrypto SHA-256 calls and input bytes were counted during range reads.
limits: The 1,900-read and 9,000-read cases use synthetic 8 KiB and 1 KiB ranges; they do not reproduce the actual engine's 256 KiB requests or unique-chunk counts.
The separate 64 MiB case uses four 16 MiB chunks and 256 KiB requests, with returned ranges reduced by the JSON wire ceiling; it is still a sample, not a captured model trace.
No model startup or inference time is extrapolated from these profiles. They do not establish browser IndexedDB latency, browser memory pressure, model download time, or inference latency.

security_checks: Signed manifest current-reference resolution remains on every plugin read.
Cache entries are keyed by exact plugin, group, scope, grant instance, and chunk path and are discarded on plugin/scope revocation or explicit group clear.
A late asynchronous read is denied after plugin revocation or cache clear.
Corrupt stored bytes are not cached and invalidate the scoped grant.
Plugin response-array mutation cannot modify broker-owned cached bytes.
LRU storage is capped at 33554432 bytes.
Verified manifest persistence is capped at 32 records and 8388608 total bytes, uses digest-keyed records, and validates exact current signed-reference metadata plus manifest SHA-256 on reuse.
Explicit group clear removes cached manifests and chunk records; asynchronous manifest caching is invalidated across clear races.
implementation_notes: IndexedDB database version 2 adds the manifests object store while preserving the existing chunks object store and records.
The version 1 to 2 IndexedDB migration path is implemented but was not exercised by this in-memory broker test suite.

verification.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/contracts build && pnpm --dir app typecheck
